g.text: duplex outlet: PE, LIGHT, N, MOTOR

g.desc: duplex outlet: PE, LIGHT, N, MOTOR

g.text: 3. PS1 feeds VSYS through D2, so USB may stay plugged in (the control side is SELV). Flash by UF2 (BOOTSEL) or SWD. Drive GP4 at 8-12 mA.

g.desc: 3. PS1 feeds VSYS through D2, so USB may stay plugged in (the control side is SELV). Flash by UF2 (BOOTSEL) or SWD. Drive GP4 at 8-12 mA.

g.text: triac; hand-wheel period from edge timestamps; speed loop every half-cycle (120 Hz); stall watchdog. Added: isolation, relay, inputs.

g.desc: triac; hand-wheel period from edge timestamps; speed loop every half-cycle (120 Hz); stall watchdog. Added: isolation, relay, inputs.

g.text: RP2350B CORE BOARD (pins by GPIO number)

g.desc: RP2350B CORE BOARD (pins by GPIO number)

g.text: 2. Pins (RP2350B): FIRE GP4; RELAY GP5; ZC GP6; HALL GP7; STITCH GP10; NEEDLE GP12; knee, pedal, FSR, limit on ADC0-3 (GP40-43),

g.desc: 2. Pins (RP2350B): FIRE GP4; RELAY GP5; ZC GP6; HALL GP7; STITCH GP10; NEEDLE GP12; knee, pedal, FSR, limit on ADC0-3 (GP40-43),

g.text: 5. R7/R8: ~3.9 mA peak in the H11AA1; R11: ~8 mA into U3 from 3.3 V; R6/C2 fitted only if a snubberless triac false-fires.

g.desc: 5. R7/R8: ~3.9 mA peak in the H11AA1; R11: ~8 mA into U3 from 3.3 V; R6/C2 fitted only if a snubberless triac false-fires.

g.text: 4. Fire only after a zero-cross has been seen and the command is zero; close K1 last and open it first. Never scope the line side.

g.desc: 4. Fire only after a zero-cross has been seen and the command is zero; close K1 last and open it first. Never scope the line side.

g.text: ADC4-7 spare; GP8/GP9 UART1 for a debug line (or USB serial). Avoid GP0 (PSRAM select on some boards), GP23, GP25 (key, LED).

g.desc: ADC4-7 spare; GP8/GP9 UART1 for a debug line (or USB serial). Avoid GP0 (PSRAM select on some boards), GP23, GP25 (key, LED).

g.text: 6. On a WeAct RP2350B Core board, feed PS1 to the 5V pin: the board has its own diode from USB VBUS, so D2 may be left out.

g.desc: 6. On a WeAct RP2350B Core board, feed PS1 to the 5V pin: the board has its own diode from USB VBUS, so D2 may be left out.
